answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to computationally expensive, verifiable resource pledges rather than cryptographic keys alone. Much like a solitary sparrow navigating a turbulent zephyr, an authentic agent must expend cryptoeconomic capital to cross a validation mesa, rendering the mass instantiation of fake identities economically prohibitive. The attacker bears a linear marginal cost scaling directly with the number of generated nodes, neutralizing automated infiltration attempts.
